core_obligations: Direction (1) => (2): homotopy colimits commute with cohomology sheaves and each perfect E_n has countable section sets locally, being locally a finite complex of finite free modules; hence H^i(K) has countable section sets over affines (proof lines 8571-8576).

Setup for (2) => (1): pick a K-injective representative K^bullet of K, a perfect generator E with K-injective representative I^bullet, and use the dga equivalence F of the Ddga theorem to view K as the dg module M = Hom(I^bullet, K^bullet) over (A, d) = Hom(I^bullet, I^bullet), with H^i(A) = Ext^i(E, E) and H^i(M) = Ext^i(E, K); since F and its quasi-inverse commute with homotopy colimits it suffices to write M as a hocolim of compact objects of D(A, d) (proof lines 8579-8601).

Conclude: by the countable dga lemma it suffices that Ext^i(E, E) and Ext^i(E, K) are countable, which is exactly the countable-cohomology lemma applied with the countable section sets of O_X and of the H^i(K); hence K is a homotopy colimit of perfect objects (proof lines 8602-8606).
proof_roadmap: Prove (1) implies (2) from commutation of hocolim with cohomology (proof lines 8571-8576).
Transport K through the dga equivalence to a dg module M (proof lines 8579-8601).
Write M as a hocolim of compacts via countability of the Ext groups (proof lines 8602-8606).
